title: 第1章 机缘暴击系统第2章 盘龙玉佩
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
洪武天域。
神风城，江家！
“嗯……”
一阵轻哼声传出，床铺上的少年悠悠睁开了双眼，茫然的打量着四周的环境。
“这是什么地方，我……”
“嘶～”
刚呢喃了没两句，脑海中突然传来了一股巨痛，一段陌生的信息不断在脑海中浮现。
四大家族，江家二少爷，江尘！
“我这是穿越了？”
将脑海中信息消化完毕后，江尘脸上露出了一个错愕的神情。
他原本是蓝星之人，不久前还在和室友网吧开黑，没想到一醒来就出现在这陌生的地方。
随着不断整理脑海中的信息，江尘脸上的震惊之色越来越浓，眉宇间显得有些兴奋。
洪武天域，以武为尊，修炼到一定的境界后，上可九天揽明月，下可翻倒海翻江。
【修炼等级：锻体境，神海境，造化境，洞天境，破虚境，三魂境，生死境，道合境。
随着越来越多的记忆被消化，江尘的脸色逐渐变得难看了起来。
自己的身世确实还算不错，是神风城四大世家之一，父亲虽不是江家家主，但权力也仅次于家主而已。
可让江尘郁闷的是。
自己穿越的这一具身体，修炼天赋可以说是奇差无比，这一身锻体五重的修为都是用药物堆积起来的。
关键是这家伙还自我感觉良好，觉得自己的天赋万古唯一，整天花天酒地。
这不。

前几天受到萧家二公子邀请，去天香阁喝花酒，之后在对方的一阵吹捧之下，江尘很快就喝得酩酊大醉。
迷迷糊糊中，他感觉好像被什么东西扎了一下，随后便逐渐失去了意识。
回想到这里后，江尘连忙将袖子挽了起来，果然发现了一个细微的孔洞，若是不仔细看，确实很容易就忽视掉了。
结合着自己目前的状况，江尘当即就明白了过来，原主人应该是被人算计了，而自己正巧捡了一个便宜。
“难道是想嘎我腰子？”
一想到暗中有人盯着自己，江尘就有一种头皮发麻的感觉。
虽然现在重生了，可这边的危险并没有解除，要是那人发现江尘并没有死，肯定还会再次想办法动手的。
江尘：“不行，既然老天给了我一次穿越的机会，一定不能就这么轻易死去。”
“我的命运只能由自己掌控！”
说了两句鼓舞自己的话后，江尘猛然间想了起来，穿越者好像都是有金手指才对。
想到这。
江尘试探性开口：“统子，你在吗？”
〈叮！
〈恭喜宿主，竟然这么快就发现了本系统的存在，特奖励你大逼兜×10！
〈机缘暴击系统绑定中……〉
呃……
听着脑海中响起的提示音，江尘感觉又惊又气。
content_en:
Hongwu Tianyu.
Kamikaze City, Jiang Family!
"Well..."
A soft hum came out, and the young man on the bed opened his eyes and looked at the surrounding environment blankly.
"What place is this, I..."
"Hiss~"
Just after murmuring a few words, a huge pain suddenly came from my mind, and a strange piece of information kept appearing in my mind.
The four major families, the second young master of the Jiang family, Jiang Chen!
"Have I traveled through time?"
After digesting the information in his mind, Jiang Chen had a look of astonishment on his face.
He was originally from Blue Star, and not long ago he was hacking in an Internet cafe with his roommate. He didn't expect to appear in this strange place as soon as he woke up.
As he continued to sort out the information in his mind, the look of shock on Jiang Chen's face became thicker and thicker, and his brows looked a little excited.
In the Hongwu Heavenly Domain, martial arts are respected. After cultivating to a certain level, you can embrace the bright moon in the sky, and overturn the sea and rivers.
[Cultivation levels: Body Forging Realm, Divine Sea Realm, Creation Realm, Cave Heaven Realm, Shattering Void Realm, Three Soul Realm, Life and Death Realm, Dao Harmony Realm.
As more and more memories were digested, Jiang Chen's expression gradually became ugly.
His background is indeed not bad. He is one of the four major families in Kamikaze City. Although his father is not the head of the Jiang family, his power is second only to the head of the family.
But what makes Jiang Chen depressed is.
The body that I traveled through has extremely different cultivation talents. The fifth level of cultivation in this body was all accumulated using drugs.
The key is that this guy still feels good about himself, thinking that his talent is unique forever, and he spends his days drinking and drinking.
No.
A few days ago, Jiang Chen was invited by the second son of the Xiao family to drink wine at Tianxiang Pavilion. Afterwards, under the compliments of the other party, Jiang Chen quickly became extremely drunk.
Drowsily, he felt as if he had been pricked by something, and then gradually lost consciousness.
After thinking about this, Jiang Chen quickly rolled up his sleeves and found a tiny hole. If you didn't look carefully, it would be easy to ignore it.
Combined with his current situation, Jiang Chen immediately understood that the original owner must have been plotted, and he happened to get an advantage.
"Are you trying to dig my waist?"
Jiang Chen felt a tingling sensation at the thought of someone watching him secretly.
Although he is reborn now, the danger here has not been eliminated. If that person finds out that Jiang Chen is not dead, he will definitely try to take action again.
Jiang Chen: "No, since God has given me a chance to travel through time, I must not die so easily."
"My destiny can only be controlled by myself!"
After saying a few words of encouragement to himself, Jiang Chen suddenly remembered that all time-travelers seemed to have golden fingers.
Think of this.
Jiang Chen tentatively spoke: "Tongzi, are you there?"
<Ding!
<Congratulations to the host, for discovering the existence of this system so quickly. I will reward you with 10 Big Pussy Bags!
〈Opportunity critical strike system is being bound...〉
Uh...
Listening to the notification sound in his mind, Jiang Chen felt shocked and angry.
